CustomField.description: Lookup to a Form_Submission__c record used as the pre-fill source for this Repeater or Table section. The formTemplatePageSection LWC loads that record (handleGetPrefillTemplateRecord) and passes it as record-template to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table, and as the record for Field Set previews. Lets a section seed default child rows/values without a Flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick a Form Submission record whose values pre-fill new repeater or table rows in this section. Use it to seed defaults without writing a prefill Flow; leave blank for empty rows.
CustomField.label: Pre-fill Template
